tr-world-thrace-marmara.basis: Turkish wine regions are informal and described by province.
tr-world-thrace-marmara.outline: Built from the administrative units that contain the area. The legal boundary follows other lines (roads, rivers, farms or altitude), so the real area is smaller.
tr-world-thrace-marmara.atlas_note: European Turkey and the Sea of Marmara coast, one of the country's main wine areas, second in output to the Aegean.
